subject: [PATCH v3 7/8] mm/page_alloc: retry alloc_contig_pages() when the zonelist is rebuilt

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch modifies the alloc_contig_frozen_pages_noprof function to retry when the zonelist is rebuilt, which can cause a zone that was previously ineligible to become eligible. This change ensures that the function correctly handles changes to the zonelist and avoids allocating pages from zones that are not suitable for the requested allocation. The patch addresses an issue where the hugetlb pool walk could put gigantic pages in ZONE_MOVABLE, which is excluded by a previous commit. The change improves the reliability of memory allocation under certain conditions, such as when kprobes hold the walk across the online process.
